services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: Sit back, relax, and enjoy the beautiful scenery of Waikiki Beach! 1 hour About Catamaran sailing is one of the best ways to sit back, relax, and just take in the beautiful scenery of Waikiki Beach and the ocean surrounding it. Let the ocean be your sanctuary away from it all and take a relaxing catamaran sail aboard the Kepoikai II Catamaran. Mai Tais, beer, and soft drinks are available onboard for purchase. Escape the ordinary aboard this beautiful vessel, head out into the open ocean, and feel the stresses of daily life being washed 1 hour • All Ages Welcome • Come set Sail with us right from the Waikiki Beach!

Departing from the shores of Waikiki, our catamaran will take you out to a serene sanctuary, surrounded by the gentle waters of Hawaii where we will gather to continue the ceremony. This journey, carefully crafted with the aloha spirit, offers a safe and sacred space for you to find comfort, closure, and beauty in the memories that you 1 hour • Morning Memorial & Celebration of Life Sails

checkin: Aloha! Mahalo for choosing Catamaran Kepoikai II! We look forward to having you aboard as our guest! We're located on the shoreline of Waikiki Beach between the Royal Hawaiian Hotel and the main Outrigger Waikiki Beach Hotel, in front of Dukes Waikiki. Please be on the shoreline at least 10 - 15 Minutes prior to your sail time for check-in.
cancellation: Cancellation Policy Customers with individual or small group bookings (1–5 guests) will receive a full refund with at least 24 hours’ notice of cancellation. For groups of 6 or more guests, or when booking more than 50% of available spots, a minimum of 72 hours’ notice is required to receive a full refund. No refunds for last-minute cancellations or no shows!
